validation_notes: The right side of the chart (mid-Jul to Aug 06) shows price oscillating in a fairly flat, rangebound band roughly between 92-100 with no clear convergence — highs and lows are not systematically narrowing. There's no consistent lower support line rising to meet a flat resistance; instead price bounces sideways with similar amplitude throughout (95-100 highs, 90-95 lows repeated). This looks more like consolidation/range-bound chop than a descending triangle apex. I don't see the flat-bottom + declining-highs structure needed for a credible descending triangle; the 'algorithm' flag seems to be picking up noise in a sideways channel rather than true compression.
